question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        fr.total_revenue / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.film_id) as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
)
SELECT 
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    f.title,
    r.revenue_per_actor,
    ROUND(AVG(r.revenue_per_actor) OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id), 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked r
JOIN actor a ON r.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON r.film_id = f.film_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, r.rn;

    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id

)
SELECT film_id, total_revenue
FROM film_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;", "preview_rows": 15}
